title: LocalObserve Security Alert Payload Schema
description: Standardized schema with x- vendor extensions for LocalObserve security telemetry alert events dispatched to webhooks, alert-receiver, and desktop notifiers.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of alert generation.

alert_name.description: Human-readable title or rule identifier of the security alert.

severity.description: Severity level mapped to notification priority.

description.description: Detailed alert payload body describing rule ID, process details, or event tags.

source.description: Telemetry source subsystem (e.g., falco, osquery, rsigma, custom-webhook).

title.description: Formatted notification title for desktop alerts.

body.description: Formatted notification body summary for desktop alerts.

x-localobserve-mitre-tactic.description: Custom extension: Mapped MITRE ATT&CK Tactic (e.g. TA0004-privilege-escalation).

x-localobserve-mitre-technique.description: Custom extension: Mapped MITRE ATT&CK Technique ID (e.g. T1068, T1059.004).

x-localobserve-action-playbook.description: Custom extension: Automated remediation action playbook trigger.

x-localobserve-remediation-link.description: Custom extension: URL or URI link to remediation documentation or runbook.

x-localobserve-github-pr.description: Custom extension: Associated GitHub PR number or branch reference (e.g. PR #64, fix/rsigma-healthcheck-and-alert-validation).
